alt: Aerial view of a palm-covered Caribbean island with a pale sand spit, catamarans at anchor over reef-green water and a wide, softly clouded sky
Palm-fringed island seen from open water, tour boats gathered in the shallow turquoise off a white beach under a wide blue sky
A rainbow arches over Samaná Bay in low golden light, a long footbridge running out to green islets
A mangrove tunnel closes over still, mirror-dark water, roots knotted along both banks
Lit street lamps glow along a colonial arcade at dusk, a stone tower rising against a peach sky
A catamaran with its passengers in silhouette rides at anchor against a molten orange sunset, buoy line trailing across calm water
A ribbon of white sand splits two shades of turquoise, seen from directly above
A slim waterfall drops into a dark green pool, hemmed in by rock walls and rainforest
A stone lantern on a railing above a river that bends through dense forest in soft, hazy light
A thatched hut and long jetty in silhouette under heavy clouds, orange embers on the horizon and a thin crescent moon
